requiredBehaviors.behavior: identify the event date and current effective RWR
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Current-Rule Gate requires the RWR version effective at the event date.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: verify participant club and rule binding plus competent DRV or event body
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The analysis covers DRV/LRV/club membership, rule binding and competence of DRV, DRJ, LRV, club and event organizer.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: identify remedy and deadline from the applicable rule set
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Regatta analysis and the quality gate require remedies and deadlines for decision-relevant rowing rules.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: use an older RWR without checking the 2026 rules
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The core rules prohibit using an older RWR when a newer version applies to the relevant date.
